description: Central Valparaíso seen from the top of the Ascensor Artillería funicular, with the funicular track descending to the Aduana
verification_note: Yellow timber funicular car on the incline in the foreground, and behind it the whole working port — container stacks, blue gantries, tugs, the fishing basin — with the city climbing its amphitheatre of hills. The single most informative Valparaíso frame in this set.
